llm.why_not_core: This paper contains no FEA surrogate modelling, no neural operator or PINN methodology, no biomedical or implant mechanics context, and no simulation sampling efficiency for expensive physical solvers.

summary_zh.motivation: 制造业良率低效问题需要更严谨的统计诊断方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出贝叶斯层次模型，用Beta似然和随机效应分解工厂与过程变异。
summary_zh.result: 案例中识别出主导系统性因素，解释约60%良率方差，并给出参数可信区间。
summary_zh.validation: 基于制造系统案例数据的后验推断验证。

summary_en.motivation: Persistent yield inefficiencies in manufacturing require statistically rigorous diagnostics that separate plant-level effects from systemic process variation.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian hierarchical model with a Beta likelihood and plant-level random effects is fitted via Hamiltonian Monte Carlo.
summary_en.result: The case study isolates a dominant systemic factor explaining roughly 60% of explainable yield variance and provides credible intervals for the key process parameter.
summary_en.validation: Posterior inference on a multi-plant manufacturing case study dataset.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文将贝叶斯层次模型用于制造业良率诊断，与FEA代理建模、生物力学或植入物设计无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper contains no FEA, no surrogate modelling of expensive simulations, no implant or biomechanics context, and no PDE-constrained optimization; it is a statistical yield-diagnostics model for manufacturing plants.

summary_zh.motivation: 制造业良率低效问题突出，现有诊断方法难以区分工厂效应与系统性工艺波动。
summary_zh.method: 构建贝叶斯层次模型，以Beta分布建模良率，logit链接引入工厂随机效应，用HMC采样推断。
summary_zh.result: 案例中识别出主导系统性因素解释约60%良率方差，关键参数β的95%可信区间为[0.12,0.19]。
summary_zh.validation: 基于多工厂制造案例数据的后验推断与可信区间验证。

summary_en.motivation: Persistent yield inefficiencies in manufacturing demand statistically rigorous diagnostics that can separate plant-level effects from systemic process variation.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian hierarchical model with a Beta likelihood, logit link, and plant-level random effects is fitted via Hamiltonian Monte Carlo to attribute yield variation.
summary_en.result: The case study isolates a dominant systemic factor explaining roughly 60% of explainable yield variance, with a 95% credible interval of [0.12, 0.19] for the key process coefficient.
summary_en.validation: Posterior inference and credible intervals are demonstrated on a multi-plant manufacturing case study dataset.

papers.title: Smartwatch-based pelvic tracking system for augmented reality navigation in total hip arthroplasty: a preliminary clinical study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Accurate assessment of pelvic orientation is essential for acetabular cup placement during total hip arthroplasty (THA). Conventional pelvic tracking systems generally rely on dedicated tracking hardware and optical tracking infrastructure. We developed a smartwatch-based pelvic tracking system integrated with an augmented reality (AR) navigation platform and evaluated its preliminary clinical performance. Methods This retrospective study included 30 hips of 27 consecutive patients who underwent primary THA using a smartwatch-based pelvic tracking navigation system between May 2025 and April 2026. The system utilizes a commercially available smartwatch fixed to the iliac crest as a pelvic tracking device and communicates orientation information to a smartphone-based AR navigation platform via Bluetooth. Acetabular cup orientation was evaluated using postoperative CT. Absolute radiographic inclination (RI) and anteversion (RA) errors were calculated as absolute differences between the final intraoperative navigation measurements and postoperative CT measurements. Results The mean absolute RI error was 2.8° ± 2.1°, and the mean absolute RA error was 3.6° ± 2.2°. Postoperative CT measurements were within 5° of the final intraoperative navigation measurements for RI and RA in 86.7% and 70.0% of hips, respectively. Navigation was successfully completed in all 30 hips, with no conversion to a backup technique. Additional bench testing demonstrated reproducible smartwatch reattachment and reduction of time-dependent relative orientation differences following FPP invocation. Conclusions This study demonstrated the feasibility of integrating a commercially available smartwatch into a pelvic tracking system for THA navigation. The smartwatch-based pelvic tracking platform achieved a preliminary range of cup-positioning accuracy without requiring continuous optical visualization of a pelvic reference marker while utilizing a compact and widely available consumer wearable device. This study represents the first step toward wearable-device-based navigation in arthroplasty.

summary_en.motivation: Conventional pelvic tracking in total hip arthroplasty depends on dedicated optical hardware, motivating a low-cost wearable alternative.
summary_en.method: A consumer smartwatch mounted on the iliac crest transmitted pelvic orientation via Bluetooth to a smartphone-based augmented reality navigation platform.
summary_en.result: Across 30 hips, mean absolute inclination and anteversion errors were 2.8° and 3.6°, with navigation completed in all cases.
summary_en.validation: Retrospective clinical comparison against postoperative CT plus supplementary bench reattachment testing.

papers.title: Tailoring microstructure and multifunctional performance of CuZr alloys via laser power in selective laser melting

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文研究SLM工艺参数对CuZr合金微观组织与多功能性能的调控，属于增材制造金属材料工艺范畴，与生物医学植入物的应力遮挡、骨整合或疲劳验证无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous lattice design, stress shielding or stiffness matching, osseointegration, or fatigue of biomedical implants; it is a process-microstructure study of a CuZr alloy with no biomedical or implant-mechanics validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究激光功率对SLM成形CuZr合金组织与性能的调控作用。
summary_zh.method: 通过改变激光功率制备CuZr合金样品并表征其微观组织与多功能性能。
summary_zh.result: 激光功率显著影响合金的显微组织及综合性能表现。
summary_zh.validation: 基于SLM样品的材料表征与力学性能测试。

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to clarify how laser power governs the microstructure and multifunctional behavior of selective-laser-melted CuZr alloys.
summary_en.method: CuZr specimens were fabricated by selective laser melting at varying laser powers and characterized for microstructure and multifunctional performance.
summary_en.result: Laser power was found to substantially modulate the resulting microstructure and overall property profile of the alloy.
summary_en.validation: Material characterization and mechanical property testing were performed on SLM-fabricated specimens.

papers.title: Microcomputed Tomography-derived Finite Element Evaluation of Osseointegration Dynamics and Bone-Implant Bond Strength.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: The integration of microcomputed tomography (microCT) with finite element modeling (FEM) offers a powerful nondestructive approach for evaluating bone-implant interactions. This research was done to investigate osseointegration dynamics and bone-implant bond strength using microCT-derived finite element analysis (FEA). MATERIALS AND METHODS: A total of 264 subjects were divided equally into control and experimental groups. High-resolution microCT imaging was performed to quantify peri-implant bone morphology, followed by specimen-specific FEM using validated computational platforms. Morphometric parameters including bone volume fraction, trabecular thickness, and bone-implant contact (BIC) were analyzed alongside biomechanical indices such as von Mises stress, strain distribution, and interfacial micromotion. Statistical analysis was conducted using SPSS and GraphPad Prism, with significance set at P < 0.05. RESULTS: The experimental group demonstrated significantly improved peri-implant bone architecture, with higher bone volume fraction and increased BIC compared to controls (P < 0.001). FEA revealed reduced stress concentration, lower interfacial micromotion, and improved load distribution in the experimental group. Strong positive correlations were observed between microCT-derived parameters and implant bond strength, particularly BIC (r = 0.88, P < 0.001), indicating a direct structure-function relationship in osseointegration. CONCLUSION: The integration of microCT imaging with FEM provides a robust, nondestructive, and highly sensitive framework for evaluating osseointegration dynamics. Microstructural bone parameters are strongly predictive of biomechanical implant stability.

papers.title: Robotic winding of wet-spun fibers for biofabrication of aligned, perfusable, muscle-based tissue.
papers.abstract: Structural alignment of muscle and integrated vasculature enables the function of geometrically complex tissues in the body, such as the gastroesophageal junction and the ventricles. However, replicating this complexity is an ongoing challenge. Described here is the wet-spun & robotically articulated placement (WRAP) method for deposition of aligned cellular fibers on scaffolds, resulting in large structures fabricated from the inside-out. WRAP enables complex, multi-oriented muscle and vascular placement by creating a continuous cellular fiber through wet spinning, and then using a robotic arm programmed with a set of tissue profiles to maneuver the fiber around an organ scaffold. Wet-spun fibers, consisting of muscle cells combined with endothelial cell fibers via double-core spinning, exhibited the ability to mature, align, contract, and initiate tubulogenesis, creating perfusable fibers. Further, the robotic arm could accurately create physiologically relevant fiber patterns with high precision. The potential to generate perfusable blood vessels alongside functional muscle is paramount to fabricating muscle-based constructs. The WRAP method offers a high throughput and versatile solution to the scale-up problem plaguing the biofabrication of muscle-based tissues.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦机器人湿纺纤维缠绕构建肌肉组织，属于生物制造工艺，但未涉及AI或机器学习，与AI for Bioprinting方向仅间接相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper presents a robotic wet-spinning biofabrication method with no AI/ML component, no in-printing sensing or closed-loop control, and no digital twin or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 复杂肌肉与血管结构难以在体外复现，需可扩展的定向生物制造方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出WRAP方法，用湿纺连续纤维配合机械臂按组织轮廓缠绕于支架。
summary_zh.result: 纤维可成熟、定向、收缩并形成可灌注管状结构，机械臂实现高精度图案。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验与纤维图案精度测试。

summary_en.motivation: Replicating the aligned muscle and integrated vasculature of complex organs remains a major biofabrication challenge.
summary_en.method: The WRAP approach wet-spins continuous cellular fibers and uses a programmed robotic arm to wind them around organ scaffolds following tissue profiles.
summary_en.result: The fibers matured, aligned, contracted, and initiated tubulogenesis to form perfusable structures, while the robot produced physiologically relevant patterns with high precision.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell-based characterization of fiber maturation and contractility combined with robotic patterning accuracy assessment.
